scope: CLI inspect explicit cumulative native work allowance

checks.command: cargo clippy -p tablecraft-cli --bin tablecraft --test inspect --test cli --locked --offline -j 2 -- -D warnings

contracts: Default native work remains 1000000; explicit native-steps accepts 1..=100000000 using the existing shared ceiling.
Inspection shares one native budget across open/container/selected mode. Explicit work does not raise byte or row limits.
A one-step allowance and an independent one-byte allowance both fail with no stdout; increased work preserves complete baseline check output and original source bytes.
Zero and above-ceiling values fail argument validation before reading.
limits: No full workspace or native Access qualification claim. Original public-writer delete corpus replay with increased work follows separately.
